# ESP-IDF third-party WT32-SC01-PLUS projects

This directory tracks external WT32-SC01-PLUS projects built primarily with ESP-IDF.

Each project keeps upstream provenance, license status, hardware assumptions, our adaptation notes, and physical evidence separate.

## Projects

- [`esp32-tux/`](esp32-tux/) — Project 4: Sukesh Akhilesh's ESP32-TUX reusable LVGL HMI template, prepared for controlled validation on the Panlee `ZX3D50CE08S-V15-USRC / 230208` reference specimen.
